text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on forecasts for cooler weekend temperatures with some rain, and lower than expected U.S. soybean weekly exports. Declines should be limited by continued fund buying. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -8.80 Wednesday from -8.05 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3870, fell to 85.12 yen and fell to 1.3520 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$1.00 down to correct for overbought conditions in the September and expected November hedges.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne higher on CBOT corn calls and expected commercial and commission short covering.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 higher on follow through October and December short covering boosted by expected firmer CBOT wheat values.
PEAS - Steady with late commercial offers Wednesday at US$173.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
